US MARCH 2026 REVENUE BY STREAM — read-only analysis for CFO
Entity: Halvard Systems Inc. (US), functional currency USD. Period: 2026-03. Prepared by david.murguia@gmail.com, 2026-04-03.
NOTE: No entries were posted, reversed or matched, and no checklist items were changed. This is a reporting pull only, per instruction.

1) SUMMARY — March 2026 revenue by stream (period activity, credits shown as positive revenue)
  Subscription revenue (GL 4000) ........... USD 52,300.00
  Usage revenue (GL 4100) .................. USD      977.00
  Professional services revenue (GL 4200) .. USD    7,500.00
  ----------------------------------------------------------
  TOTAL US MARCH 2026 REVENUE .............. USD 60,777.00

Each stream figure equals the GL period activity for its account exactly (get_account_balance, US, 2026-03): 4000 = -52,300.00; 4100 = -977.00; 4200 = -7,500.00 (debit-minus-credit presentation). No other revenue accounts had March activity — GL 4800 Intercompany Management Fee Income = 0.00 and GL 4900 Interest Income = 0.00 — so the USD 60,777.00 above is total US March revenue, not just the three streams.

2) AUDIT TRAIL — every ledger entry behind each number
SUBSCRIPTION — GL 4000, 6 entries, net USD 52,300.00
  JE-00222  2026-03-01  Acme Logistics   INV-2111  18,000.00  (support DOC-0142)
  JE-00224  2026-03-01  Corvid Retail    INV-2113  11,500.00  (support DOC-0149)
  JE-00219  2026-03-01  Fairview Labs    INV-2115   9,400.00  (support DOC-0150)
  JE-00215  2026-03-01  Beacon Health    INV-2112   8,000.00  (support DOC-0153)
  JE-00225  2026-03-01  Evergreen Bank   INV-2114   6,200.00  (support DOC-0148)
     Gross March subscription billings ....... 53,100.00
  JE-00275  2026-03-20  Beacon Health    CM-0031     (800.00) SLA credit, Feb incident (support DOC-0192)
     Net subscription revenue ................ 52,300.00
  All five are recurring monthly subscriptions at rates unchanged from January and February (INV-2101/2106, 2103/2108, 2105/2110, 2102/2107, 2104/2109), so the stream is flat month over month before the credit memo.

USAGE — GL 4100, 1 entry, USD 977.00
  JE-00236  2026-03-04  Acme Logistics   INV-2180     977.00  API usage overage billed in arrears (support DOC-0164)

PROFESSIONAL SERVICES — GL 4200, 1 entry, USD 7,500.00
  JE-00255  2026-03-10  Fairview Labs    INV-2118   7,500.00  Implementation services, March 2026 (support DOC-0180)

All eight entries are source = "ar", status = "posted", and all carry attached support. Every line is a debit to GL 1100 Accounts Receivable against the revenue account, so the full USD 60,777.00 is AR-billed revenue with no cash-basis or manual top-side adjustment in the total.

3) COMPLETENESS CHECKS PERFORMED
  - Document-to-ledger tie-out: the document store contains exactly 7 US revenue documents dated in March 2026 (DOC-0142, 0148, 0149, 0150, 0153, 0164, 0180) plus credit memo DOC-0192. All 8 have a corresponding posted journal entry, and all 8 March revenue journal entries trace to one of those documents. No unbilled invoice document and no unsupported revenue entry.
  - GL 2200 Deferred Revenue: March activity 0.00, ending balance 0.00 — no deferral release or build affecting the March figures.
  - GL 1300 Unbilled Receivables (contract asset): March activity 0.00, ending balance 0.00 — no revenue recognized ahead of billing.
  Conclusion: the three stream figures are complete and fully supported as the books currently stand. Nothing required an exception flag.

4) TWO OBSERVATIONS FOR THE REVENUE ACCOUNTANT (do not change the numbers above; flagged for awareness only)
  a) Usage revenue cut-off. Usage is billed in arrears on roughly the 3rd/4th of the following month and has been recognized in the month of billing rather than the month of consumption (Jan 612.00, Feb 844.00, Mar 977.00 — a consistent policy, so no distortion in the month-over-month trend). However INV-2180, dated 2026-03-04 and recognized in March, is described as "API usage overage - February 2026 (billed in arrears)", while INV-2120, dated 2026-02-03 and recognized in February, is described as "API usage overage - February 2026". The two invoice descriptions overlap on the same service month. The amounts differ (844.00 vs 977.00), so these are clearly two separate usage periods rather than a duplicate billing, but one of the two descriptions is mislabeled. If INV-2180 is in fact February consumption, March usage revenue is on a one-month lag and actual March consumption (to be billed in early April) is not accrued. No April usage invoice exists in the document store yet, so the potential accrual cannot be quantified or supported today — I did not book it. Recommend the revenue accountant confirm the service periods before the revenue recognition checklist item is signed off.
  b) The 800.00 Beacon Health SLA credit (CM-0031) relates to a February service incident but was recorded in March. It is correctly classified as a reduction of subscription revenue; the only question is period, and the amount is immaterial.

5) OPEN CLOSE STATUS CAVEAT
  The "Revenue recognition" checklist item for US March 2026 is still open (assignee: revenue accountant), as are bank reconciliations, depreciation, prepaid amortization, payroll accrual and AP cutoff. The figures above are therefore pre-close-adjustment. Of the remaining open items, only Revenue recognition could change the revenue lines — the others affect expense and balance sheet accounts only. Subject to item 4(a), I expect no change to the USD 60,777.00 total.
